lede: Eastern Michigan carries the stronger underlying team rating — -7.1 against -9.4, a 2.3-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Akron +7.0 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Eastern Michigan winning 68% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is run defense, where Eastern Michigan leads Akron by 57 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 83% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
